definitions.checkpoint: Atomic durable logical-task state and operation journal before effects and after receipts.
definitions.settled_source: Host generation sealed against further dispatch, with zero pending or uncertain work.
definitions.recovery: Reconcile a durable operation identity, then resume only from proven completion or proven non-execution.
definitions.handover: Idempotently stage a different host context with the exact bounded capsule before advancing generation.

product_prototype: Offline automatic checkpoint, fresh-context handover and continuation after an ARE recycle stop.
business_prototype: Measure continuity and duplicate prevention before spending model credits.

requirements: Seal and drain source before staging
Bind fresh context to capsule and generation
Commit completion and pending removal atomically
Retain constraints, facts, lessons and evidence

acceptance: Repeated offline recycling completes pending work once
Actual process crashes at journal and handover boundaries recover
Pending and uncertain work blocks successor creation
Corrupt, drifted and stale receipts fail closed
Native source-built Codex contexts resume through the real ARE policy with mock provider
open_questions: How will production host receipts prove tool quiescence and durable operation lookup?
Which live meter proves complete request bounds?
How will native app-server expose typed recovery without an offline test adapter?
